Custom R-Function LLM Coding Backend Adapter

Source: R/backends.R
backend_custom.Rd

Wraps any R callable fn(request) — such as an offline airgapllm pipeline, local Python/C++ model wrapper, or custom heuristic scorer — into an llm_backend compatible with code_texts(), preserving full JSON schema validation, retries, content-addressed caching, resumable checkpointing, and downstream G-study/DPF/PPI analysis with zero extra package dependencies.

Usage

backend_custom(fn, name = "custom", version = "1.0", metadata = list())

Arguments

fn

A function accepting a single request list (containing unit_id, text, prompt_id, prompt_text, model, temperature, replicate, schema, attempt, previous_errors, and meta). fn may return:

  • a JSON character string,

  • a named R list matching the fields of request$schema,

  • a 1-row data.frame matching request$schema, or

  • a full response list containing content (plus optional model and raw_response).

name

Descriptive identifier for the custom backend (included in content-addressed cache keys). Default "custom".

version

Version string for cache invalidation when fn changes. Default "1.0".

metadata

Optional named list of extra cache-key metadata (e.g., model weights hash or runtime parameters).

Value

An object of class c("llm_backend_custom", "llm_backend").

Examples

my_scorer <- backend_custom(
  fn = function(req) list(score = nchar(req$text) / 10),
  name = "length_scorer",
  version = "1.0"
)
texts <- tibble::tibble(
  id = c("u1", "u2"),
  text = c("Short note", "A slightly longer diary entry")
)
des <- coding_design(prompts = c(p1 = "{text}"), models = "local")
code_texts(texts, "text", id_col = "id", design = des, backend = my_scorer)
#> 
#> ── LLM Coded Data (default_design) 
#> Units: 2 | Rows: 2 | Valid: 2/2 | Failures: 0
#> Cache (memory): 0 hits, 2 misses
#> # A tibble: 2 × 9
#>   unit_id prompt model temperature replicate score cache_hit attempts valid
#>   <chr>   <chr>  <chr>       <dbl>     <int> <dbl> <lgl>        <int> <lgl>
#> 1 u1      p1     local           0         1   1   FALSE            1 TRUE 
#> 2 u2      p1     local           0         1   2.9 FALSE            1 TRUE
